claims.statement: src/styles/globals.css is the single theme source of truth using Tailwind v4 CSS-first configuration: @import 'tailwindcss', @plugin 'tailwindcss-animate', a class-based dark custom-variant, an @theme inline block mapping utility colors to HSL CSS variables covering background/card/popover/brand/primary/destructive/financial/status/availability/telegram and the full chart role set, with light :root and .dark concrete values; tailwind.config.ts is deleted and components.json points at globals.css with cssVariables enabled.

The token layer is regression-tested by src/styles/__tests__/globals-token-contract.test.ts (every required semantic role declared and mapped) and globals-compiled-contrast.test.ts (real PostCSS-compiled output resolves to concrete colors and foreground/background pairs meet WCAG contrast in both themes), which is why token edits additionally require npm run build.

src/components/ui/** primitives are domain-agnostic shadcn/Radix wrappers that render only semantic-token surfaces with no hardcoded or light-only palette values, hardened a11y (Select focus return, Progress forwarding zero, ≥44×44 native localized close controls, min-[20rem] title space, semantic invalid states, named table scrollers, motion-reduce variants) while preserving all existing exports, variants, portals, and compatibility props; pinned by primitive-behavior-contracts.test.tsx and primitive-semantic-surfaces.test.tsx.

The ui Slider forwards caller ARIA attributes (aria-label, aria-labelledby, aria-describedby, aria-valuetext, aria-valuenow/min/max, aria-invalid, aria-required) from the Radix root down to the thumb — conditionally so absent attributes are not rendered — with a semantic focus-visible ring and motion-reduce:transition-none on the thumb.

src/components/product/** are presentational, route-supplied composition families (page context, metrics, filters, tables, charts, states) that own no URL/search/debounce/persistence/query/API/store logic; each family ships a source-contract test with an explicit Story-owned manifest rejecting route/API/hook/query/store/raw-palette ownership, and the product root barrel re-exports only page-context, metrics, and filters while tables/charts/states are consumed via their subtree barrels.

Product composition honesty invariants: PageHeader renders exactly one logical h1; ContextBar and availability/status presentations convey semantic state as localized text never color alone; zero and missing stay distinct (nullish/non-finite metric input never becomes a fabricated zero; terminal PageState/chart states never fabricate retained content); compact FinancialValue display requires a caller-supplied fullValue so the full value is accessible without a tooltip.

Story 174.2 enforces a repository-wide design-system boundary: scripts/check-shadcn-ui-boundary.mjs (Node stdlib) scans all production src/**/*.{ts,tsx} for LEGACY_PALETTE and CONTEXTUAL_HEX patterns and ratchets against scripts/.shadcn-ui-boundary-baseline.txt (523), exiting 0 at-or-below the baseline and 1 only on increase; suppression requires a BOUNDARY_EXCEPTIONS entry with an owner/debt ID mirrored in the classification manifest, and the scanner has a 10-case self-test suite.

The design system targets WCAG 2.2 Level AA for all migrated surfaces (the PRD's WCAG 2.1 AA is the minimum), defined in _bmad-output/planning-artifacts/ux-design-specification.md and repeated as the story accessibility contract across all Epic 166–174 story plans.

Story 174.3 executes an inclusive visual contract via e2e/shadcn-migration-visual-accessibility.spec.ts over exactly 76 ledger routes: for every theme × width it asserts exactly one visible route h1 preceding the first data surface (generic error/not-found shells rejected), no document overflow beyond +2px, reduced-motion media match, color-scheme matching the applied theme, and at 390/1280 an AxeBuilder run with tags wcag2a, wcag2aa, wcag22aa plus in-page computed-text contrast (4.5:1 normal, 3:1 large/bold) measured by compositing foreground over effective ancestor background.

The 174.3 surface inventories self-verify at import time: evidence(source, anchor) in e2e/fixtures/story-174-3/surface-types.ts reads each cited production file and throws if missing or if the anchor string is absent, and the feature-disposition builder throws unless every table surface assigns exactly one disposition to all 8 table features and every chart surface to all 7 chart features.

Chart surfaces in the 174.3 inventory must declare an exact semantic data alternative — an sr-only data-chart-summary table or explicitly-named summary carrying required period/unit tokens and series tokens — plus the owner vitest test that pins exact tooltip units, precision, and values; charts lacking a period dimension (e.g. the unit-economics point-in-time waterfall) record a not-applicable rationale for period-and-units instead of faking one, and multiple charts may share one complete data table via the shared-complete-data-table association.

The 174.3 keyboard/focus runner Tab-walks route-owned interactive controls and requires a visible focus target with focus-specific computed styling and :focus-visible; overlays are verified at 390px in both themes — keyboard open (Enter, and Space for the mobile sheet) moves focus into the dialog, contains forward/reverse Tab, stays within the viewport, and Escape closes and restores focus to the exact trigger — while non-modal popovers assert intentional focus without a modal-trap claim.

200% zoom evidence is produced only by real browser UI zoom: e2e/story-174-3-real-browser-zoom.spec.ts runs solely through the headed macOS orchestrator (STORY_174_3_REAL_BROWSER_ZOOM=1 plus ready file), asserts root CSS zoom stays 1/normal, devicePixelRatio at least doubles and innerWidth shrinks accordingly, and then requires all 76 routes to keep the document bounded with main inside the viewport in both themes.

Below the e2e matrix sits a vitest a11y layer: *.a11y.test.tsx files across analytics, dashboard, financial-summary, moysklad, and orders components serve as the tooltip/interaction owner tests cited by the 174.3 inventories (e.g. UnitEconomicsWaterfall.a11y.test.tsx exposes exact percentage/currency units, categories, values, and precision).

Semantic-token honesty is pinned by exact classList DOM tests: pnl-waterfall semantic-tokens.test.tsx pins text-financial-positive, the AA-contrast idiom of a bg-financial-positive/10 tint with foreground text, and named help/formula tooltip buttons while rejecting a widened legacy-palette regex; sku-financials ProfitabilityBadge.test.tsx pins the /15 chip idiom (bg-financial-negative/15 + text-foreground, explicitly not text-financial-negative), Russian-locale margin formatting, and a no-fabricated-zero fallback to the status label when marginPct is null.

ResponsiveChartFrame (src/components/custom/analytics/ResponsiveChartFrame.tsx) is the shared positive-size wrapper for Recharts ResponsiveContainer: a relative min-h-[240px] frame (overridable) that prevents width/height=-1 mount warnings and couples sizing to semantics — with a label it takes role="img" plus aria-label and aria-describedby pointing at the exact data alternative; without a label no image role is applied.
